How it works

                
            

            

                
    
                    
  1. Source — use Image to convert a photo, or Text to render typed words as big block-letter ASCII.
    2. 
                    
  2. Upload an image — drag & drop or click to browse.
    3. 
                    
  3. Width — sets how many characters wide the output is.
    4. 
                    
  4. Characters — pick a shading ramp; denser ramps show more detail, or choose Custom… to type your own (brightest first, faintest last).
    5. 
                    
  5. Invert — for art meant to be seen on a light background.
    6. 
                    
  6. Colored — renders each character in the source pixel's colour (great with Blocks).
    7. 
                    
  7. Export — copy the text, or download as .txt or colored .html.
    8.
